newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Riyadh governor Prince Salman will inaugurate a 937.5 million riyal power station in the capital Riyadh on Sunday.
- Japan imported goods from Saudi Arabia worth $7.61 billion in 1994 and exported goods worth $2.74 billion to the kingdom.
- King Fahd called for an end to Israeli atrocities.
- Riyadh governor Prince Salman signed a 54.4 million riyal contract to build two mosques with the World Centre for Trade and Contracts.
- Sino-Saudi trade likely to rise by 888.7 million in 1996.
- Five gas stations in Riyadh closed down amid a price war.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines transported a record 1,322,249 passengers in August.
